notes: Welcome sizzle reel edit list. Times are in the source video. 0.5s crossfades; the last shot crossfades back into the first so the loop is seamless. Optional per shot: crop (ffmpeg w:h:x:y, applied before scaling), flip (mirror horizontally), pip {crop, width, x, y} (overlay another region of the same frame, e.g. a webcam tile).
